title: CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Gold, Silver, Oils & Brass Scrap (Notification No. 69/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated August 10, 2026)
content:
# CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Gold, Silver, Oils & Brass Scrap (Notification No. 69/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated August 10, 2026)

Ek important update hai. Government ne gold, silver, oils, aur brass scrap ke Customs Tariff Values revise kiye hain. Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) ne Notification No. 69/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated August 10, 2026, announce kiya hai, jo August 11, 2026 se effective ho gaya hai.

Is notification ke through, CBIC ne Notification No. 36/2001-Customs (N.T.) dated August 3, 2001, ke Tables 1, 2 aur 3 ko substitute kiya hai, jisme specified goods ke tariff values diye gaye hain.

**Key Revisions/Updates:**

*   **Gold:** Tariff Value ab US$ 1,395 per 10 grams set kiya gaya hai.
*   **Silver:** Tariff Value ab US$ 2,076 per kilogram set kiya gaya hai.
*   **Oils (Crude Palm Oil, RBD Palm Oil, Crude Palmolein, RBD Palmolein, Crude Soybean Oil) & Brass Scrap:** In commodities ke tariff values mein koi change nahi kiya gaya hai aur yeh pehle jaise hi hain.
    *   Crude Palm Oil: US$ 1,211 per Metric Tonne (MT)
    *   RBD Palm Oil: US$ 1,212 per MT
    *   Crude Palmolein: US$ 1,222 per MT
    *   RBD Palmolein: US$ 1,225 per MT
    *   Crude Soybean Oil: US$ 1,255 per MT
    *   Brass Scrap: US$ 7,639 per MT
*   **Areca Nuts:** Inka tariff value bhi US$ 10,785 per MT par unchanged hai.

Importers aur custom brokers ke liye yeh update crucial hai taaki woh apne customs valuation aur import duty calculations ko latest notified values ke according adjust kar saken.
